title: Garage setback from the primary street
text: C3.3.3 Garages are set back from the primary street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3c. Table 3.3c Setback of garages from the primary street: R2-R35 5.0m (Refer Figure 3.3c); R40 and above In accordance with Table 3.3a. In areas coded R2 - R35, setback of garages to the primary street may be reduced: i. to 4.5m where an existing or planned footpath, shared path or road alignment is located more than 1m from the street boundary; or ii. to 3m where the garage allows vehicles to be parked parallel to the street. The wall parallel to the street must include more than one opening.

exceptions.label: footpath or road more than 1 m from boundary

replaces.note: 4.5 -> 5.0 m at R2-R25; garage-adjoins-dwelling (Figure 8b) reduction deleted
R30-R35 5.0 m (4.5 m footpath reduction) unchanged

notes: Identical to Chapter 2 C3.3.3. R40 and above are governed by Table 3.3a (C3.3.3#r40-plus). Reduction paragraphs are un-numbered in the draft.
